source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entries 1476 and 1477 require an activity type and replace the positional return tuple with issuer, allScopes and requiredScopes properties. The accepted function returns all scopes for a provider with a single string, or the mapped activity scope plus extra for a protocol map; it returns undefined for an unsupported mapped type. requiredScopes controls token reuse, while allScopes is the provider authorization set. Keep those meanings separate in this OAuth API; this is a scoped implementation contract. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source adoption does not establish reviewer approval.
title: OAuth provider details separate all supported scopes from required activity scopes
